intro.en: The vocabulary of history books: reigns, wars, treaties and the centuries, with a short look at Spain's own past.

texto.en:
**Time.** **El siglo** is written in Roman numerals and read as a cardinal number: **el siglo XV** is el siglo quince. **A principios de**, **a mediados de**, **a finales de** siglo. **La época**, **la era**, **la Edad Media**, **la Edad Moderna**. **Antes de Cristo** (a. C.) and **después de Cristo** (d. C.).

**Power.** **Un rey** has **un reinado**; **un emperador**, **un imperio**. **Gobernar**, **reinar**, **heredar el trono**, **abdicar**.

**War.** **Estalla** una guerra. **El ejército** **invade** un país, **lucha en** una batalla, **vence a** su enemigo or sufre **una derrota**. The loser **se rinde**. Countries on the same side are **aliados**. At the end, they **firman un tratado de paz**.

**The tenses of history.** The indefinido tells the events: **estalló**, **duró**, **murió**. The imperfect describes the background: **era**, **había**, **vivían**. The historical present makes them vivid: en 1492 Colón **llega** a América. And the passive is common: **fue conquistada**, **fue firmado**.

**Spain in one paragraph.** The Romans called it Hispania. From 711 much of the peninsula was Muslim **al-Ándalus**, for almost eight centuries. In 1492 the Catholic Monarchs took Granada and Columbus reached America. **La Guerra Civil** lasted from 1936 to 1939 and was followed by **la dictadura** of Franco, who died in 1975. Then came **la Transición** to democracy and the Constitution of 1978.

frases.es: La Guerra Civil española estalló en julio de 1936, cuando una parte del ejército se levantó contra el gobierno de la República.
frases.en: The Spanish Civil War broke out in July 1936, when part of the army rose against the government of the Republic.
analisis: contra el gobierno de la República

frases.es: Lo que los militares esperaban resolver en unos días duró casi tres años y dividió a familias enteras.
frases.en: What the military expected to settle in a few days lasted almost three years and divided whole families.
analisis: Lo que los militares esperaban resolver

frases.es: Ambos bandos buscaron aliados fuera, de modo que España se convirtió en el ensayo de la guerra que vendría después en Europa.
frases.en: Both sides sought allies abroad, so that Spain became the rehearsal for the war that would come afterwards in Europe.

frases.es: La República fue vencida en abril de 1939, y medio millón de personas cruzó la frontera hacia el exilio.
frases.en: The Republic was defeated in April 1939, and half a million people crossed the border into exile.

frases.es: Siguió una dictadura que se prolongó hasta la muerte de Franco, en 1975.
frases.en: There followed a dictatorship that lasted until the death of Franco, in 1975.

frases.es: Durante la Transición, los partidos pactaron no pedir cuentas por el pasado para que la democracia fuera posible.
frases.en: During the Transition, the parties agreed not to settle scores over the past so that democracy would be possible.
analisis: no pedir cuentas por el pasado

frases.es: Casi un siglo después, la guerra sigue presente en la política, en la literatura y en la memoria de muchas familias.
frases.en: Almost a century later, the war is still present in politics, in literature and in the memory of many families.
analisis: en la política, en la literatura
en la memoria de muchas familias

pregunta.en: According to the text, how long did the war last?

A few days.en: That is what the military expected.

Forty years.en: That is roughly how long the war and the dictatorship lasted together.

pregunta.en: According to the text, why did the parties agree not to settle scores?

So that democracy would be possible.en: Para que la democracia fuera posible.

bloques.correcta: So that democracy would be possible

pregunta.en: How is el siglo XVIII read?

el siglo dieciocho.en: Centuries are read as cardinal numbers.

el siglo decimoctavo.en: Ordinals are only usual up to ten.

conquistada.en: The participle agrees with la ciudad.

conquistado.en: It must agree with la ciudad: feminine.

bloques.frase: El ejército enemigo se rindió sin luchar.

texto.en: The enemy army surrendered without fighting.
The enemy army performed well without a fight.
The enemy army returned without fighting.

bloques.frase: A mediados del siglo veinte terminó la guerra

traduccion.en: In the middle of the twentieth century the war ended.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a summary of a key period in the history of your country for a Spanish reader.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud a historical event that still divides people in your country today.
